The point-collinearity strongly regular spectrum yields all zero-sum D_p eigenvalues; explicit strict inequalities exclude other modes before the unique bipartition root. A standalone stdlib checker performed 209288 exact graph recurrence comparisons for classical q=2,3,5 and scalar tests for q=2..199, supplementing rather than proving universal facts.
